scope: sampled visual and story review; ASR and measured signal support; no validated audio listening
product_from_film: Riffle presents a collaborative music workspace with samples, layered tracks and an assistant for musical parts.
explains_well: A selected sample becomes a track, an assistant proposes a bassline, and the workspace leads to a shareable player.
unclear: The rapid collage makes it hard to tell which musical changes belong to the same piece, especially without hearing the audio.
scenario: Build a layered piece from samples, ask for a bassline and share it.
product_clear_basis: A colored multitrack workspace appears after the Riffle introduction.

lessons.keep: Make AI assistance a visible addition to a human-owned artifact.
lessons.avoid: Avoid using dense collage to hide the actual difference made by a feature.
lessons.open: Audio changes, musical quality, precise transitions, collaboration behavior, asset rights and all soundtrack details remain unverified.
try: Show a Tin user making a campaign, asking for one missing asset and adding the result into the existing plan.
Preserve one creation from selection through edit and shared preview with matching labels at each step.
